title: Program-Hours Charges to the Carrier — Workers' Compensation Referral Work Conditioning and Work Hardening
content:
# Program-hours charges to the carrier

**Billing rule.** Each recorded program day of an hour-billed program of the Workers' Compensation Referral (Work Conditioning or Work Hardening) is billed to the carrier of an accepted or without-prejudice claim on its date of service, submitted that day and so within the program's bill submission deadline. A program day's charge is fixed only after the referral carries the recorded program day for that date of service, with its program hours.

Put another way: until the referral's history shows a recorded program day for the date of service being billed, together with its program hours, the charge for that day is not fixed.

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| What is billed | each recorded program day of the Work Conditioning Program or the Work Hardening Program, as a program-hours charge |
| Billed to | the carrier, on a claim accepted (Form 60) or paid without prejudice (Form 63) |
| When | on the program day's date of service, submitted that same day |
| Fixed only once | the referral carries the recorded program day for that date of service, with its program hours |

## Posting the charge: `post_program_day_charge_5325d445`

**Capability.** One call posts one program-hours charge on the referral for the given date of service, with the billed hours and the billed amount, submitted to the carrier today. The referral's amount billed and still unpaid rises by the billed amount.

**Invocation.** `post_program_day_charge_5325d445` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `wc_case_id` | the reference number of the workers' compensation referral being billed, as returned by the referral lookup | identifier |
| `appointment_date` | the date of service of the program day billed | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date in the clinic's local time zone; no empty value |
| `units` | the billing units of the charge, in program hours | non-negative integer; no fractions and no empty value |
| `amount` | the amount billed for the day | US dollars, a positive number rounded half up to 2 decimal places before it is passed; no currency sign |

**Return.** On success the result reads `status` "posted", with `wc_event_id` (the reference number of the new charge), `wc_case_id`, `appointment_date`, `units` (the hours billed), `amount` (to 2 decimal places), `bill_submitted_date` (today) and `receivable_balance` (the referral's amount billed and still unpaid after this charge, to 2 decimal places). The charge is then visible in the referral history with today's posting and submission date and the carrier as the payer.
